_notes: Every key is a use-case slug (same slugs as openai/skills imagegen, so prompts stay portable).
template  = ordered labelled lines handed to the image generator.
defaults  = fallbacks used only when neither the request sheet nor templates/brand.json sets that line.
Resolution order per line: request-sheet column -> brand lock (look/studio) -> recipe default.
Lines that resolve to empty are dropped automatically.
Keep clauses SHORT - long avoid-lists dilute the instruction. 5-8 clauses is the sweet spot.

product-mockup.label: Catalog / product shot on clean background
template: Subject: {subject} - match the reference product exactly: shape, proportions, material, colour, hardware, stitching and label placement.

defaults.scene: seamless studio background, clean even gradient, subtle contact shadow under the product
defaults.lighting: large softbox key light, soft fill, controlled gentle shadow
defaults.constraints: true-to-reference colour and proportions; clean silhouette; crisp material micro-detail
defaults.avoid: text; logos that were not requested

photorealistic-natural.label: Lifestyle / in-use photo
template: Subject: {subject} - keep it consistent with the reference image if one is supplied.

defaults.scene: real-world everyday environment that suits the product
defaults.style: candid editorial photograph, real textures, natural colour balance
defaults.lighting: natural daylight, soft direction, realistic shadows, shallow depth of field
defaults.constraints: unretouched skin, fabric and surface texture; believable real-world detail
defaults.avoid: studio gloss; plastic skin; distorted hands

identity-preserve.label: Keep the exact product/person, change only the scene
template: Constraints: keep the subject from the reference exactly as it is - same shape, proportions, material, colour, texture, label and hardware; change only what the primary request names; relight it to match the new scene and keep shadows consistent; {constraints}

defaults.constraints: no redesign and no restyling; no added or removed parts
defaults.avoid: altered proportions; invented logos or text

precise-object-edit.label: Change/remove one thing, keep everything else
template: Constraints: change only the element named in the primary request; keep the rest pixel-faithful - same framing, background, lighting, geometry, colours and shadows; match the surrounding texture and perspective where the edit lands; {constraints}

defaults.style: keep the original photo look, resolution and colour
defaults.constraints: no global recolour; no re-crop; no re-lighting

background-extraction.label: Clean cutout / transparent or white background
template: Style/medium: clean product cutout with crisp edges, the product itself is not restyled

Constraints: clean transparent background (or pure white #FFFFFF if transparency is unsupported); crisp anti-aliased silhouette; no halo and no leftover shadow; label text exactly as in the reference; the whole product inside frame; {constraints}

defaults.avoid: harsh drop shadow; background remnants; jagged edges

compositing.label: Place the product from a reference into a new scene
template: Input images: {refs} - Image 1 is the product reference (identity lock); later images are the scene/environment reference
Constraints: matched perspective, scale, ground contact and shadow direction; the product itself stays unchanged; realistic reflections; {constraints}

defaults.style: photorealistic composite that reads as a single photograph
defaults.lighting: scene lighting applied to the product - same direction, colour temperature and shadow softness
defaults.avoid: cut-out look; hard outline; colour cast mismatch; mismatched shadow direction

lighting-weather.label: Same shot, different light / time of day
template: Constraints: change only light, shadow, atmosphere and colour temperature; keep framing, geometry, composition and subject identity identical; {constraints}

defaults.constraints: no new objects; no re-crop; no change to the product itself
defaults.avoid: moved camera; different lens; added props

style-transfer.label: Apply a look while keeping the subject
template: Input images: {refs} - Image 1 is the subject; later images are the style reference
Constraints: copy only the style cues (palette, texture, finish, lighting character); keep the subject recognisable and unchanged in shape and proportions; {constraints}

defaults.style: apply the reference style consistently across the whole frame
defaults.avoid: style drift; half-styled regions; new objects

sketch-to-render.label: Line drawing / CAD / sketch to photoreal render
template: Input images: {refs} - Image 1 is the sketch/drawing to render
Composition/framing: {framing} - keep the sketch's proportions, layout and perspective exactly
Constraints: turn the supplied drawing into a realistic render without adding, removing or moving any element; {constraints}

defaults.style: photorealistic render with physically plausible materials
defaults.lighting: studio lighting, soft key and fill
defaults.constraints: respect the drawing's dimensions and proportions

text-localization.label: Replace in-image text, keep layout
template: Style/medium: keep the original art style, typography weight, spacing and hierarchy
Text (verbatim): {text} - render exactly these characters, no extra characters, no misspellings
Constraints: change only the text; preserve layout, background art, logo placement, colour and spacing; {constraints}

defaults.constraints: match the original font style, weight and letter spacing
defaults.avoid: reflowing the layout; added copy; gibberish lettering

infographic-diagram.label: Diagram / infographic with labels
template: Composition/framing: {framing} - clear top-to-bottom or left-to-right reading flow
Text (verbatim): {text} - every label spelled exactly as given, no extra words
Constraints: strong contrast; generous spacing; clean arrows and callouts; legible labels; {constraints}

defaults.style: clean vector-like infographic, flat colours, crisp lines
defaults.constraints: no watermark; no logos or trademarks
defaults.avoid: cluttered layout; duplicate labels; photographic texture

logo-brand.label: Logo / mark exploration
template: Composition/framing: single centred mark on a plain background with generous padding; {framing}
Constraints: original design only; strong silhouette; balanced negative space; readable at small size; {constraints}

defaults.style: vector-style logo mark, flat colours, minimal detail
defaults.constraints: no gradients unless essential; no trademarks
defaults.avoid: photorealism; 3D bevels; drop shadows; clutter; invented slogans

ui-mockup.label: App / web UI screen
template: Composition/framing: {framing} - clear hierarchy, practical spacing, realistic content density
Constraints: shippable-looking UI; legible typography; consistent spacing and corner radius; {constraints}

defaults.style: realistic product UI, not concept art
defaults.avoid: fantasy sci-fi UI; unreadable text; overlapping elements

defaults.style: cinematic concept art with consistent art direction

illustration-story.label: Illustration / comic panels
template: Constraints: consistent character design across panels; readable actions; {constraints}

defaults.style: storybook illustration, clean line work, warm palette
defaults.avoid: inconsistent characters; extra panels; gibberish text

historical-scene.label: Period-accurate scene
template: Constraints: period-accurate clothing, props, materials and environment; no anachronisms; {constraints}

defaults.style: photorealistic photograph consistent with the stated period
